verdict.rationale: Project or space organization is a fair axis for a chat assistant like Grok, but the evidence pack never describes grouping related chats and files into a project or space with shared context or instructions. The 'team workspace' items (grok-docs-13, grok-docs-39) are about business-plan account separation and privacy. Connectors (grok-docs-11, grok-docs-36) give access to external files inside a single chat, not shared project context.
